# TipBox

> Named stochastic box models, empirical records, early-warning indicators, and trajectory-level ROC/AUROC benchmarks in Python.

Use `from tipbox.models import MayHarvesting` and `model.make_trajectory(n, noise=..., seed=...)` for a simulation. The returned `TrajectoryResult` has `time` shape (T,), `trajectory` shape (T,D), `param_values` shape (T,), and provenance in `metadata`.

Use `from tipbox.datasets import generate_dataset` for labeled pre-reference contexts: observations (N,T,D), labels (N,), absolute time (N,T), and per-row metadata. Explicitly distinguish full simulation `n` from retained context `num_timesteps`. Model clocks, observables, noise meanings, and event rules differ.

Rolling statistics return NumPy arrays aligned to the input, with NaN at warm-up, skipped, or invalid windows. Use integer windows for streaming. One trajectory supplies one score; larger scores mean tipping. Predeclare directions and analysis settings. Do not infer an empirical null class or a physical time unit that the source does not establish.

Use `from tipbox.datasets import Microcosm, Paleoclimate` and `Microcosm().load()` or `Paleoclimate().load()` for empirical observations. All five system-named observation classes expose `.load()` with explicit cache and offline controls; functional loaders remain available. Records preserve source times, missing values, and provenance.

## Start here

- [Complete quickstart](_sources/quickstart.rst.txt): Installation, simulation, causal indicators, labeled ROC, and one empirical recovery.
- [API contracts](_sources/api.rst.txt): Imports, required inputs, return shapes, and failure behavior.
- [Model controls](_sources/usage.rst.txt): Parameter overrides, grids, initial states, forcing, and innovations.

## Scientific reference

- [Master system catalog](_sources/systems.rst.txt): Every public model class, sim-to-real simulation component, and observation class, grouped by dataset type.
- [Citations](_sources/citations.rst.txt): Suggested KEWS citation and research using TipBox.
- [Model collection](models/index.html): Equations, generated default-parameter tables, units, and reference-event rules.
- [Indicator definitions](_sources/indicators.rst.txt): AR1 versus Pearson correlation, variance, population moments, detrending, and missingness.
- [Benchmark protocol](_sources/benchmarks.rst.txt): Outcome-conditioned labels, seed allocation, reference alignment, and ROC conventions.
- [Observed records](_sources/datasets.rst.txt): Original sources, checksums, licenses, missing data, recovery intervals, and the unresolved mitochondrial clock.

## Optional

- [Figure reproduction](_sources/figures.rst.txt): Fixed presets, export controls, and numerical provenance.

- [Historical compatibility](_sources/compatibility.rst.txt): Removed generators, numerical corrections, and legacy-interface conventions.
